items.title: 52060_Eddie Barefield oral history interview
items.q: So we left out from Harrisburg, and we would -- he had -- at this time Keg Purnell was playing drums... in the band.

ctx.x: And so we were going to take a trip down in Virginia, but we had to stop off in Harrisburg -- I think that's Pennsylvania -- to play a night. So we played in Harrisburg. And so Max says, well, look, we'll hit on the road, and we'll go on down in Virginia, stop off at a motel on our way down, you know, before we get to this town in Virginia we're going to play.

So we left out from Harrisburg, and we would -- he had -- at this time Keg Purnell was playing drums, had three blacks, three whites in the band. So we stopped at this hotel, and Max would get out. So he used to come, said, 'Okay, fellows. The room's -- we can go in here. We can go in there
the guy would and see we're black guys, and they'd make some excuse that we couldn't stay there, you know.
